set.body: Roadmap: bd-01KWWWGMETE2R216KQZWVAJKYV. Scope: cross-module integration and downstream fallout from typed-core changes. Acceptance: after each implementation slice, fix downstream compile errors caused by intentional type/API improvements rather than reverting the improvement; keep module READMEs and build aliases aligned if public workflows change; run both JVM and JS tests for touched modules and their dependents; finish with sbt compileAll and sbt testAll or a documented blocker. This is a standing cleanup/gate mote for broad refactor fallout.
set.title: Track downstream fallout and JVM/JS verification for typed-core hardening
